brief:
Israeli occupation forces began demolishing a house belonging to the Shahab family in Al-Naqar neighborhood of Qalqilya city, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation was underway as of the report.

The demolition adds to a pattern of home destruction in Palestinian areas. Qalqilya, located in the northern West Bank, has faced repeated Israeli military operations and settlement expansion pressures.
title: Israeli bulldozers demolish home in Qalqilya's Al-Naqar neighborhood
